insights.vad.averageLoudnessFine: mean across the whole speaking window
insights.vad.burstsPerCycleFine: separate peaks in the energy envelope
insights.vad.classTableStory: "With mic data" is how many learners in the class have ANY row in the VAD-fed tables. The rest have none at all — no account, no mic, or never a voiced cycle — so they are counted here rather than averaged in as zeros anywhere else on this board.
insights.vad.emptyFine: Nothing is broken and nothing is being hidden: no learner here has produced a single voiced cycle the VAD could measure, so there is no distribution to draw.
insights.vad.emptyLead: No learner in {scope} has mic-derived data yet.
insights.vad.jumpedInEarlyFine: started speaking before the prompt finished · over {n} events
insights.vad.latencyStory: One point per learner: their mean response latency NORMALISED by phrase length — milliseconds per character of the target, which is how the engine compares a short word against a long sentence. Higher is slower. Over {n} learners with a latency series, not the whole roster.
insights.vad.latencyTitle: How long they take to start speaking
insights.vad.learnersWhoHaveDataSub: {n} of {total} in {scope}. Click a row for that learner's own adaptive-pause read.
insights.vad.masteryStory: Each bar counts (learner, LEGO) pairs the adaptive pause engine has a state for, over the {withData} learners in {scope} carrying mic-derived data — not all {total} on the roster. A LEGO climbs acquisition → consolidating → confident → mastered as the learner's responses come back smooth and fast enough, run after run.
insights.vad.masteryTitle: Adaptive pause mastery, across the learners who have mic data
insights.vad.peakLoudnessFine: mean of each cycle's loudest moment
insights.vad.prosodyAvailablePart2: events from {learners} learners. Only what the envelope payload actually carries — nothing inferred.
insights.vad.prosodyUnavailablePart1: Prosody is unavailable right now — the server read didn't answer, and
insights.vad.prosodyUnavailablePart2: is own-row under RLS so the browser can't read it directly. This is a stated gap, not a set of zeroes.
insights.vad.stillGoingAtVoice1Fine: hadn't finished when the model spoke · over {n} events
insights.vad.uptakeFine: {legos} per-LEGO latency series · {events} prosody events from {withProsody} learners
insights.vad.uptakeFineCapped: · capped read, so these are a floor, not a total
insights.vad.uptakeReadHasData: They are never averaged into anything below: every figure here is taken over the {withData} who do have data.
insights.vad.uptakeReadIntro: {withData} of the {total} learners in {scope} have mic-derived data. The other {rest} have no row at all in the VAD-fed tables — not zeros, nothing.
insights.vad.uptakeReadNoData: So there is nothing to average, and nothing below pretends otherwise.
